              End the event

              Archives everything recorded at this booth, then clears it for the next event. The archive is written and read back before anything is erased.

              This cannot be undone from the dashboard. The archive file is the only copy, so copy it off this machine before reimaging or returning it.

              Archive and reset

              Deliberately typed rather than clicked, because this erases every attendee record at this booth.

              Clear the public leaderboard

              The public leaderboard is shared by every booth, so resetting this booth leaves it as it is. Clearing it removes every drink name from the board and sets the count back to 0, for all booths. The service keeps a copy of the old board.

              Do this only after every booth has ended its event. This booth must hold no event records: archived and reset, or a staff machine that has served no one.

              Clear for every booth

              Attendee data lives on this machine, not in the repository. Deleting the cloned repository does not remove it.
